## [Forgotten Island](https://www.forestcinema.co.uk/event/111616)

![PG](https://www.forestcinema.co.uk/ratings/UK/PGlrg.png)

Running time: 109 mins

Your best friendship is worth fighting for. DreamWorks Animation, the studio that brought you unforgettable bonds between a boy and a dragon in How To Train Your Dragon, an ogre and a donkey in Shrek, and a robot and a gosling in The Wild Robot, now welcomes a dazzling and emotional story about two lifelong best friends who must come together before they drift apart in Forgotten Island. The new original film is written and directed by Academy Award-nominee Joel Crawford and Januel Mercado and is produced by Academy Award-nominee Mark Swift, the filmmaking team behind Puss in Boots: The Last Wish. Grammy and Academy Award-winning supernova H.E.R. and Liza Soberano star as high school graduates Jo and Raissa, who have been best friends since grade school but are now about to embark on separate life paths. While celebrating their last night together, Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali, packed with magical and mythological creatures they grew up hearing stories about from their Filipino families. Some of these figures will become friends, some foes. Joined by well-meaning-but- hapless weredog Raww and a small-but-mighty pack of pals, Jo and Raissa must face The Dreaded Manananggal, the most feared creature on the island. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa will race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever. The film's all-star voice cast also includes Dave Franco, Lea Salonga, Jenny Slate, Manny Jacinto, Dolly de Leon, Jo Koy, and Ronny Chieng.

# Hire Us

## Private Cinema Hire at Forest

 

#### Your Own Screen, Your Own Film, Your Own Way

 

Ever dreamed of having a cinema all to yourself? Now you can! Forest Cinema is available to hire – perfect for birthdays, celebrations, big screen gaming, or simply watching your favourite film in private.

 

#### What’s Included:

- Comfy seating and great sound for the ultimate private cinema experience

 

- Capacity: 50 seats + 2 wheelchair spaces

 

 

- Film options: Choose from our current film line-up.

**Please note:** If selecting a film from our current programme, private hires can take place **one week after its general release.**

 

#### Pricing

Hire fees vary by day and season:

 

- Monday to Thursday: £300

 

- Friday to Sunday: £450

 

- School & Christmas Holidays: £450

 

We recommend booking at least 2 weeks in advance.  
Availability may be limited during busy periods.

 

 

#### T&C’s

For birthday parties or private hires for a younger audience (under 18) please note that at least one adult (over 18) will need to be in attendance.

 

A cleaning charge may be applicable if the auditorium is left in a considerably poor state after your hire.

 

Full payment is required to confirm your slot, but this is fully refundable up to a week prior to the date of your booking if you need to cancel.

 

#### **Booking & Payment**

Full hire cost is required to secure your booking via bank transfer.  
To enquire or book your private hire, please contact:
